items.title: 迪拜批准逾110亿迪拉姆公共设施与地铁延伸项目
items.title_en: Dubai approves over AED11 billion in community facilities and metro extension plans
items.summary: 迪拜执行委员会于11月10日批准预算95.9亿迪拉姆的社区服务及公共设施发展计划（至2040年），以及预算20亿迪拉姆的迪拜地铁延伸至Al Maktoum International Airport City计划，合计115.9亿迪拉姆。这些是已批准的发展计划，并非EPC承包合同授予。
items.summary_en: On 10 November, Dubai's Executive Council approved an AED9.59 billion programme for community services and facilities through 2040 and an AED2 billion Dubai Metro extension to Al Maktoum International Airport City, totalling AED11.59 billion. These are approved development plans, not awarded EPC construction contracts.
items.why_it_matters: 公共建设与轨道延伸可能在后续阶段形成大型土建及设备需求，具体标段仍待发布。
items.why_it_matters_en: Future stages may generate significant civil engineering and equipment needs, subject to publication of work packages.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注地铁土建、站点机电、公共建筑、设计咨询及中资承包商合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track metro civil works, station MEP, community facilities, design services and Chinese contractor partnerships.

items.title: 阿治曼Al Zorah与DAMAC签署30亿迪拉姆滨水综合开发协议
items.title_en: Ajman's Al Zorah and DAMAC sign AED3 billion waterfront mixed-use development agreement
items.sector: 滨水住宅与房地产开发
items.summary: 11月10日，Al Zorah Development Company与DAMAC Properties签署土地收购协议，拟在阿治曼Al Zorah溪岸开发价值约30亿迪拉姆的滨水住宅综合项目，规划总建筑面积约140万平方英尺。土地协议签署不代表总承包合同已授予。
items.summary_en: On 10 November, Al Zorah Development Company and DAMAC Properties signed a land acquisition agreement for an approximately AED3 billion mixed-use waterfront residential development along the creek in Ajman, with planned built-up area of around 1.4 million square feet. The land agreement is not a construction contract award.
items.why_it_matters: 开发主体、投资价值和项目位置较明确，可提前跟进建设及精装修供应链。
items.why_it_matters_en: The developer, project value and location are defined, presenting early-stage construction and fit-out leads.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注住宅施工、建材、家具、机电、精装修和劳务供应。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor residential construction, materials, furniture, MEP, fit-out and workforce supply.

items.title: Nakheel公布380万平方米Palm Springs可持续住宅总体规划
items.title_en: Nakheel unveils 3.8 million sqm Palm Springs sustainable residential masterplan
items.sector: 住宅社区与配套基础设施
items.summary: Nakheel于11月10日公布邻近Palm Jebel Ali的Palm Springs大型住宅社区总体规划，占地约380万平方米，规划容纳近5万名居民，设15个社区及学校、医院、体育、商业等配套设施，另规划超过35公里步行、慢跑和自行车路线。项目获LEED for Communities Platinum预认证，尚未宣布各施工包授标。
items.summary_en: On 10 November, Nakheel unveiled Palm Springs, a 3.8 million-square-metre sustainable residential masterplan beside Palm Jebel Ali, intended for almost 50,000 residents across 15 neighbourhoods with schools, a hospital, sport and retail facilities and more than 35 km of walking, jogging and cycling routes. It has LEED for Communities Platinum Precertification. Individual construction awards were not announced.
items.why_it_matters: 总体规划规模较大，但建设时间表与招标标段仍需后续跟踪。
items.why_it_matters_en: A large masterplan with potential multi-phase construction demand; procurement packages and timelines remain to be confirmed.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注住宅建设、公共设施、道路景观、机电、建材及运营配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track residential construction, community facilities, landscaping, MEP, materials and operations support.

items.title: 沙迦SNOC向SLB授予扩大天然气钻井框架合同
items.title_en: Sharjah SNOC awards SLB expanded gas drilling framework agreement
items.summary: 沙迦国家石油公司SNOC于11月10日公布授予SLB扩大欠平衡连续油管钻井（UBCTD）框架合同，新的作业规模约为首期两倍，预计于2027年在Moveyeid气田储气开发及Hedebah气田开展新阶段作业。合同金额未披露，属于已授服务合同。
items.summary_en: On 10 November, Sharjah National Oil Corporation announced an expanded Underbalanced Coiled Tubing Drilling (UBCTD) framework award to SLB. The next campaign is expected to be roughly twice the size of the initial project, beginning in 2027 across the Moveyeid gas storage and Hedebah gas fields. Contract value was not disclosed; this is an awarded services framework.
items.why_it_matters: SLB获授合同后可能存在设备、现场保障及油服分包供应机会，但主服务合同已授出。
items.why_it_matters_en: The awarded framework may create ancillary equipment and field-support demand, while the prime services contract is already awarded.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注钻井配件、油田物流、现场服务和工业物资供应合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor drilling consumables, oilfield logistics, site services and industrial supplies.
items.stage: 钻井服务框架授予／2027年作业

items.title: 阿布扎比Al Dhafra四座钢结构人行天桥正式开工
items.title_en: Construction begins on four steel pedestrian bridges in Abu Dhabi's Al Dhafra region
items.summary: 阿布扎比Al Dhafra地区于11月10日启动四座人行天桥施工，选址涉及Ghayathi City、Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed International Road及Madinat Zayed道路节点。桥梁采用钢格构结构，配置楼梯、电梯及无障碍设施。尚无披露合同金额或新的公开招标。
items.summary_en: On 10 November, construction began on four pedestrian bridges across Abu Dhabi's Al Dhafra region, at locations including Ghayathi City, Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed International Road and Madinat Zayed. The steel-lattice bridges will provide stairs, lifts and accessible crossings. No contract value or new open tender was disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: 已进入施工阶段，可了解钢结构与电梯安装的配套供应，但不应称为开放EPC招标。
items.why_it_matters_en: Works are underway, suggesting potential ancillary steelwork and lift-installation supply, not an open EPC tender.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注钢结构加工、升降设施、道路配套和公共工程材料。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor structural steel, lift systems, roadside facilities and public-works materials.

items.title: 阿曼食品安全实验室成果签署100余项农业食品投资协议
items.title_en: Oman's Food Security Lab yields over 100 agricultural investment agreements
items.summary: 阿曼11月10日宣布Food Security Lab 2026成果，包括超过100份农业和食品相关土地使用权协议，涉及总投资逾7700万阿曼里亚尔，覆盖约9000英亩，分布于多个省份。这是项目组合协议，不是单个厂房或工程合同。
items.summary_en: On 10 November, Oman announced more than 100 usufruct agreements arising from Food Security Lab 2026, covering agricultural and food-related projects with investment exceeding RO77 million across approximately 9,000 acres in multiple governorates. This is a portfolio of land-use agreements, not one factory or awarded construction contract.
items.why_it_matters: 农业及食品本地化可带来加工、仓储、冷链及设备供应机会，但需逐个项目确认。
items.why_it_matters_en: Food-sector localisation may create processing, cold-storage and equipment needs, subject to individual project identification.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进农业设备、食品加工、包装生产线、冷库及供应链服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track agricultural machinery, food processing, packaging lines, cold storage and supply-chain services.

items.title: 阿曼Al Jabal Al Akhdhar公布旅游交通配套进展及430万里亚尔已完成市政项目
items.title_en: Oman's Al Jabal Al Akhdhar reports tourism transport initiative and RO4.3m of completed municipal projects
items.category: 交通站合作签署／旧项目进展
items.summary: 11月10日报道，阿曼Al Dakhiliyah省与Mwasalat签署在Birkat Al Mouz约13644平方米地块合作开发、建设及运营公交换乘站的协议，规划客运、停车、充电和旅游服务设施。同场汇报已完成市政项目超过430万阿曼里亚尔；该金额是已完成工程总计，并非新签公交站项目合同价值。
items.summary_en: A report dated 10 November details a cooperation agreement between Al Dakhiliyah Governorate and Mwasalat to develop, construct and operate a public transport station on about 13,644 square metres at Birkat Al Mouz, with transport, parking, charging and tourism facilities. The forum also reviewed completed municipal projects exceeding RO4.3 million; that amount is not the value of the newly agreed bus-station project.
items.why_it_matters: 公交站合作是新进展，既有430万里亚尔市政项目不能误计为本次新增投资。
items.why_it_matters_en: The new bus-station cooperation is relevant, but RO4.3 million of completed municipal works should not be counted as fresh investment.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注客运站设施、停车充电、旅游配套及建筑施工。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor bus-terminal facilities, parking and EV charging, tourism services and construction.
items.stage: 公交站合作协议／已完成项目盘点

items.title: 阿曼Al Ghubrah 3海水淡化厂工程建设完成93%
items.title_en: Oman's Al Ghubrah 3 desalination plant reaches 93% construction completion
items.summary: 阿曼公共服务监管局于11月10日宣布马斯喀特Al Ghubrah 3海水淡化厂工程完成约93%，投资约1.25亿阿曼里亚尔，设计日产30万立方米淡化水，预计2027年第二季度初开始运营。主体工程接近完工，不是新增总包招标。
items.summary_en: On 10 November, Oman's Authority for Public Services Regulation reported that Al Ghubrah 3 desalination plant in Muscat is about 93% complete. Investment totals approximately RO125 million, planned capacity is 300,000 cubic metres per day and start of operations is expected early in Q2 2027. This is a near-completion milestone, not a new construction award.
items.why_it_matters: 可关注设备维护和运营服务，现阶段新建主工程商业机会相对有限。
items.why_it_matters_en: Operations and maintenance supply may be relevant as the plant nears completion, while new main-construction opportunities are limited.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注反渗透膜、泵阀、化学品、机电维护与水务运营配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor RO membranes, pumps, valves, chemicals, MEP maintenance and water-utility operations.
items.source_name: Oman News Agency / Times of Oman
